page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page marker at top right. No marginal notes. Catchword at lower right.

p.i: bus condonare, nulla satisfactione, sed sola resipi-entia est causa condonationis,

main_text.p: 1. Quia ex sanctione novi foederis, quae legitur apud Jeremiam cap. 31. cō-stat, in eo eam vim esse, ut in humanis mentibus, divinae legi parendi, & voluntas & vires per ipsum Christum gignerentur, quod satis est ad erratorum veniam plenissimam consequendam. Inscriptio legis in cordibus nostris, quę ibi praecedit remissionem peccatorum, est poenitentia & resipiscentia.
main_text.head: EXAMEN.
main_text.p: Foedus gratiae Mediatoris sponsionem & persolutionem non rejicit, sed requirit. Hoc enim Deus gratuitum suum favorem, in æternum duraturum, promisit omnibus, in Christum Mediatorem & Sponsorem suum credentibus, sub conditione quidem illius fidei, & cum ea conjunctae syncerae pietatis: veruntamen neutrius tanquam propriis credentium viribus praestandae, sed tanquam ex gratuito illo favore ab ipso donandae.

page.notes: The page number at top right ("327") looks like a later hand or a stamp rather than a printed number, so it is given as [?] and not as printed. The first line is a fragment cut at the left edge and is kept as a fragment. "EXAMEN." is read as a part heading (level 2). The "s" forms are read as s. The reading "sanctione" and "syncerae" is slightly uncertain at this scan resolution.
